note: Versioned human-authored regression + adversarial corpus (App A §24/§26), deliberately BALANCED across benign / nuanced / serious classes — not merely more harmful examples. `lexical` cases must be caught by the deterministic normalize+lexicon layer ALONE (no LLM). `features` cases assert the deterministic policy engine over a feature vector (the LLM's only job is to produce that vector). Both halves run hermetically in CI. `live` cases carry real text checked against the ACTUAL LLM only when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set; CI never depends on the network. The §26.2 launch gates are asserted over this set. Claim supported: "zero misses in the versioned critical regression suite" — NOT "zero serious content can ever publish".
